name: omniassess-ai
description: AI-powered adaptive assessment and career readiness platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,ml -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix ml-service"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix ml-service --ignore-scripts || true
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix ml-service
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.vercel-build: npm run install:all && npx prisma generate --schema backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
